acceptedInterpretation: Implement only M1 of the source-lineage/dedup playbook seed plan: a host-neutral read-only learning source lineage audit command and smoke/docs coverage. This story must not implement seed observe, batch proposal apply, candidate approval, automatic activation, runtime blocking policy, or PLAYBOOK_DONE_SETTLEMENT_ENABLED default-on.
notes: The potentially broader user goal includes historical experience batch-to-candidate and automatic promotion, but this story intentionally accepts the narrow read-only audit milestone first so later mutating promotion work has lineage evidence and cannot double-count sources.
